title: Patient-centered data science: an integrative framework for evaluating and predicting clinical outcomes in the digital health era

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct an empirical measurement, but proposes a theoretical framework for evaluating this bias via continuous internal validation, intersectional data collection (the social exposome), and ongoing analysis of model outputs across vulnerable populations.
